---
title: Scholar metadata for a YAML bibliography with a duplicate key
format: html
google-scholar: true
bibliography: references-duplicate.yaml
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      shouldError: default
      printsMessage:
        level: ERROR
        regex: 'references-duplicate\.yaml:5:3: references\[0\]: duplicate key "title"'
---

The bibliography repeats the `title` key in one reference. Pandoc rejects it, so the render fails with an error pointing at the duplicate.

This article cites one work [@cited].
